insurer: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Plan-dependent (Base Sum Insured options shown: 5/7.5/10/15/20/25/50/75/100/200 Lakhs depending on plan)

great.name: Room rent (default): At Actuals / no capping
great.quote: Room rent limit shall be ‘At Actuals’ unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule.
great.explanation: No room rent cap by default (unless your Policy Schedule/plan variant states otherwise). This avoids proportionate deductions due to room category in most cases.

great.name: Built-in additional Sum Insured buffer: Secure Benefit (after base SI exhausted)
great.quote: The Secure Benefit will be applicable only after exhaustion of Base Sum Insured.
great.explanation: Extra insurer-provided buffer becomes available once Base Sum Insured is used up (amount depends on plan as per Policy Schedule/Annexure C).

great.name: Restore Benefit: covers same illness too (Automatic Restore Benefit)
great.quote: The restored Sum Insured can be used even for the same illness for which an admissible claim has been paid during the Policy Year and also for any other Illness covered under the Policy.
great.reference: Section B.2.6 (Automatic Restore Benefit), point vi, page 18
great.explanation: Restoration is usable even for the same illness within the same policy year, which is better than many policies that restrict restore to unrelated illnesses.

great.name: Post-hospitalization: 180 days
great.quote: Such expenses shall be indemnified if the same were incurred upto 180 days unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule, immediately post the date of discharge from the Hospital.
great.explanation: Covers follow-up costs for up to 180 days (strong coverage).

great.name: NCB/Renewal Bonus (non-resetting): Plus Benefit (50% irrespective of claims)
great.quote: This Cover will be applied irrespective of number of claims made under the expiring Policy.
great.reference: Section B.2.4 (Plus Benefit), point c, page 16
great.explanation: Renewal bonus under Plus Benefit does not get wiped out just because you made a claim (availability depends on the plan/Policy Schedule).

great.name: Consumables covered via optional Protect Benefit (non-medical expenses list / Annexure B)
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Insured Person for the Non-Medical Expenses listed under Annexure B to this Policy incurred in relation to a claim admissible under Section B-1 (Base Coverage)
great.explanation: If Protect Benefit is opted/inbuilt in your plan, many typical consumables/non-medical items (e.g., gloves, masks etc. listed in Annexure B) can be covered, reducing out-of-pocket.

good.name: PED waiting period: 36 months
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months (Unless specified otherwise in the Policy Schedule) of continuous coverage
good.explanation: 3-year PED wait is standard in the market and considered acceptable.

good.name: Specific illness/procedure waiting period: 24 months
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.reference: Section C.1.b (Specified Disease/Procedure waiting period), page 28

good.name: Initial waiting period: 30 days
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident

good.name: Pre-hospitalization: 60 days
good.quote: Such expenses shall be indemnified if the same were incurred upto 60 days unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule, immediately prior to the date of admission.
good.explanation: Covers diagnostic/doctor expenses up to 60 days before admission (standard to good).

good.name: Emergency Air Ambulance (optional cover)
good.quote: The Company shall indemnify expenses incurred by the Insured Person during the Policy Year towards Ambulance transportation in an airplane or helicopter for Emergency Care
good.explanation: Air ambulance is available if the cover is in force as per Policy Schedule (limits as per schedule).

good.name: Domiciliary hospitalization covered
good.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Medical Expenses incurred during the Policy Year on Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.explanation: Covers eligible treatment at home under defined situations.

good.name: Home Health Care covered (cashless only)
good.quote: This Cover is not available on reimbursement basis.
good.explanation: Home healthcare is available but only through the insurer’s cashless/pre-authorized process.

good.name: Optional cover trade-off: Aggregate Deductible (self-chosen)
good.quote: The Insured Person shall bear an amount equal to the Aggregate Deductible specified on Policy Schedule once in a Policy Year post which coverage shall commence under this policy
good.explanation: Optional deductible can reduce premium but you pay the chosen amount first each policy year before coverage starts.

bad.name: Consumables (if Protect Benefit not opted/inbuilt): Non-medical items excluded
bad.quote: Non-Medical expenses such as food charges (other than patient’s diet provided by hospital), laundry charges, attendant charges... Full list of Non-Medical Expenses is attached as ANNEXURE B
bad.reference: Section C.3.k (Specific Exclusions) & Annexure B, pages 32 and 49-50
bad.explanation: If Protect Benefit is not in force, many consumables/non-medical items (gloves, masks, kits etc.) are out-of-pocket.

unclear.name: Co-pay (base plan): not explicitly stated as 0% / no co-pay
unclear.quote: Co-Payment means a cost sharing requirement under a health insurance policy that provides that the policyholder/insured will bear a specified percentage of the admissible claims amount.
unclear.explanation: This document defines co-pay but does not clearly state whether a co-pay applies by default for this policy/plan. Verify co-pay (if any) in your Policy Schedule/plan chosen.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
